Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj once visited this sacred village in present-day Pakistan. In this vlog, we explore Nanaksar, a historic Sikh village near Jhang that still preserves memories of a forgotten past.
Located around 15 km from Jhang, Nanaksar was once home to Sikh families before the Partition of 1947. Today, only about 150 households live here, but the village still holds a priceless piece of Sikh heritage — the ancient Gurudwara Nanaksar, believed to be associated with Guru Nanak Dev Ji Maharaj.
